ShortDescription.Value: Play however your brain wants. The mod remembers the rest.

Publish.LongDescription:
# ADHD Gone Wild — seems about right.
Ever started fixing a roundabout… and ended up with three half-built metro lines, half a park, the beginning of a harbor, and no memory of the original problem?
Ever opened one panel… and suddenly the whole screen was yelling at you?
Ever played for “five more minutes”… and somehow it’s tomorrow?
No productivity hacks. No focus police. No forcing your brain into a checklist.
ADHD Gone Wild clears the noise, remembers the loose ends, and lets your brain wander wherever it wants.
## What it does
* **Park an idea** - Ctrl+I, then click anywhere. A ring marks the spot; click the ring later and it opens. * **One short list** instead of the same warning on forty buildings. Mute anything you would rather not hear about, and unmute it whenever you like. * **A safety net** - one click saves a way back before you try something, one click returns. * **Welcome back** - where you were, and what you left there. * **A calmer screen** - map icons stop pulsing, and the build toolbar folds away. * **Reminds you to drink water** - while you are hyperfocusing. It never suggests stopping.
Everything can be switched off on its own. Nothing is written into your save games. English, French and Italian.
## Early days
This is a first release and the mod is nowhere near finished. Plenty is still planned, some of what is here will change, and a few things are certainly rough.
**Please leave a comment.** What helps, what gets in the way, what you wish it did. And if you have ADHD, how any of this actually lands for you - that is worth more to me than a bug report, because it is the part I cannot work out on my own.
## Thanks
To my girlfriend, and to her ADHD. Between them they shaped this mod far more than I did.
Publish.ChangeLog:
Fixes, mostly from what the first players ran into. Thank you for the reports.
- **Fixed: the build toolbar could come back folded after using the safety net**, with the demand bars, zoning, services and bulldozer gone and no obvious way to bring them back. Every city now opens with the toolbar out, and while it is folded the fold button sits tucked against it instead of floating alone over the map. - **Fixed: "Keep what I did" was pushed outside the panel**, so there was no way to let a checkpoint go. - **Fixed: the mod's own icons drew black** on the dark panel and were nearly invisible. They now take their colour directly instead of inheriting it. - **New: you can choose the colour of the mod's panels** - Options, Appearance. Only the shade changes, so they stay dark enough to read wherever you put the slider. - Removed the colour-blind palette option and the small shapes beside each row. The palette only ever repainted a 4px bar, and what a row means is in its words, not its colour.
